# Feature: Dashboard shell

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #21 -->

## Intent
The home view shows run quality, budgets, regressions, findings, and test context — never a single score (PRD §10). React+Vite app in `apps/dashboard` using UI_STYLEGUIDE tokens, light/dark.

## Preconditions
- Local API exists (#20)
- Styleguide `docs/UI_STYLEGUIDE.md`

## Happy Path
- [ ] PRD §10 routes exist as empty/loading/error-capable pages
- [ ] No "Performance Score" as a single number on the home view
- [ ] Run token is not stored in localStorage/sessionStorage under secret-like keys
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] API down → error state with retry, not an endless spinner
- [ ] Token taken from `?token=` into memory only

## Regression
- [ ] Local API tests still pass
- [ ] Scope: `apps/dashboard/**` — no core internals, no CSS-framework brand copy

## Assumptions
- CLI URL printing of the dashboard comes in a later ticket; this slice reads `?token=` and `?api=`
- Screens are honest empty states, not full timeline UX

## Security Coverage
- F-03: no token/secret/password in localStorage or sessionStorage
- F-05: no API keys in the client bundle
- F-01: waived (loopback)

## Screenshots
Not applicable for this slice (empty-state shell; `@verify-ui` on later tickets).

## Implementation Notes
- `apps/dashboard`: Vite + React router shell for PRD §10 routes. Empty/loading/error states. No overall performance score.
- Token from `?token=` kept in module memory (`session.ts`). Source does not call localStorage/sessionStorage.
- Project home probes the local API; unreachable → error + Retry.
- `pnpm --filter dashboard dev` on 127.0.0.1:5173.
